name: nc/slider
title: Carousel
description: Series of slides: scroll-snap by slide (effect slide) or one slide at a time with a cross-fade (effect fade). Optional arrows, dots, autoplay with a pause button, loop and speed.
aiHints: Always set a descriptive label: it becomes the accessible name of the carousel. Each child is a slide. Use effect fade for one slide at a time (perView is ignored). autoplay is in seconds between slides, 0 = off; with autoplay a pause button is always shown. loop false: autoplay makes one pass, returns to the first slide and stops. settings.controlsPosition below (default) puts arrows and dots under the slides; bottom-left, bottom-right, bottom-center put them over the slides. Style them with the groups controls (arrows: background, color, border, radius, padding, focus) and carousel (controlSize, dotColor, dotColorActive, controlsInset). content.prevLabel, nextLabel, pauseLabel, playLabel replace the button names read by screen readers.
